title: ATTP VR Table Tennis – now in Moldova!
body_html:
After a successful showing at the Olympic Esports Week in Singapore 2023, and with yesterday’s opening of the first ITTF Esports World Championship in Sweden, table tennis in the Republic of Moldova is moving into its next historic dimension thanks to the initiative and efforts of the ATTP team.

Moldova’s best table tennis players, masters of sport and talented young athletes will be able to compete in innovative virtual reality (VR) table tennis tournaments at ATTP and TOP CUP Academy venues.

From next year, this ATTP project will make it possible to hold VR table tennis championships in Moldova — fast and dynamic even across different levels of play, with the ability to customise and adapt the playing environment for each participant.

This event and ATTP’s initiative mark a fundamental and significant leap in the digital evolution of the sport in the Republic of Moldova.
